note: Predictions for the Builds by board grid (tools/render_projects.py matrix_rows, shown on portability-proven.html#builds). should_work: a cell nobody has run, predicted from a sibling that Works in the same project (sibling, sibling_result) after a fit check (fit: SDK, memory, peripherals, header); the basis is the cell's hover. not_for_chip: a project the chip or its vendor software cannot run (why_not is a key in site_ui.REASONS; label overrides the hover word). Neither is a measured result: a cell only shows these while it has no run of its own, and the renderer fails if a sibling stops being Works. Added 2026-10-22; method in docs/research/builds-grid-run-plan-2026-10-22.md.
